jobs.company_description: DVT's technology teams have transformed great ideas into successful software solutions for over 23 years.
jobs.must_have_skills: Azure, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Cybersecurity, SIEM, Incident Response, Identity & Access Management, Documentation
jobs.description_snippet: DVT is one of the top software development companies on the continent. Our software engineers are consulting on cutting edge applications at top companies in South Africa, as well as consulting globally. You will have the opportunity to work alongside some of the most established developers in the country and globally with the latest technologies. DVT is committed to continuously training our staff and we are very proud of our culture of learning, internal speaking and training at a variety of sponsored technical events across the Microsoft ecosystem. We are looking for an Azure Cloud Security Engineer for a contract with a client in the banking sector. You will design, implement and optimise security controls across the client's Microsoft Azure environments, with a strong focus on Zero Trust architecture built on Microsoft security tooling. You will configure and manage Microsoft Entra ID, deploy and tune the Microsoft Defender suite, and design and build Microsoft Sentinel SIEM capability, from data connector onboarding and detection rules through to automated incident response. You will also support secure cloud landing zones and guardrails, and align controls to Zero Trust, CIS and NIST. This is a delivery-focused role. You will work closely with the infrastructure, cloud and security teams, produce technical documentation and hand over knowledge where required. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, mid-level cloud security engineer with current Microsoft security certification, who works well on their own in a complex, regulated enterprise environment. **Role Summary** This is a mid-tier, hands-on Azure cloud security engineering role with three focus areas. First, identity-centric Zero Trust: Conditional Access, Identity Protection, Privileged Identity Management and MFA / passwordless in Microsoft Entra ID. Second, threat protection: deploying and optimising Defender for Cloud, Endpoint, Identity and, where applicable, Office 365. Third, security operations: designing and implementing Microsoft Sentinel, including connectors, analytics rules, workbooks and SOAR automation. The role is a contract with an urgent start and a hybrid working model with limited time on site. The Environment * A regulated retail banking environment within a large South African retail group * Microsoft Azure as the cloud platform, with secure landing zones and guardrails * Microsoft Entra ID as the identity platform, moving toward identity-centric Zero Trust * The Microsoft Defender suite (Cloud, Endpoint, Identity and Office 365) for threat protection * Microsoft Sentinel as the SIEM / SOAR platform, with Logic Apps for incident automation * Security controls aligned to Zero Trust, CIS and NIST frameworks * Hybrid working model: Pretoria (Centurion preferred) or Cape Town, with infrequent office attendance **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** Zero Trust Architecture * Design and implement Zero Trust security architectures across Azure environments * Implement security co

jobs.description_snippet: **Required skills** * AI Research \& Engineering **TL;DR** Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm. **About Davis** =============== Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a **$5.5M pre-seed** co-led by **Heartcore Capital** and **Balderton Capital**, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. **The Role** ============ You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically. You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself. **What you will be working on** ------------------------------- * **Corpus from raw sources.** Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable. * **Synthetic data generation.** Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data. * **Canonical representation and curation.** Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage. * **Pretraining data and mixtures

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.must_have_skills: Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud (GCP), Networking, Virtualisation, Identity & Access Management
jobs.description_snippet: **About Share** Share is a venture backed company building the marketplace for bandwidth: the infrastructure layer that connects internet capacity suppliers to every individual and business that runs on it. Today, bandwidth is the most in-demand asset in the world, but its buy/sell process is highly fragmented and inefficiently priced. Share brings the supply and demand together by building distributed routing nodes and connecting carriers, ISPs, data centers, and enterprise buyers through a neutral exchange, turning bandwidth into a liquid, tradeable resource. We're building the category-defining marketplace for how bandwidth gets bought, sold, and delivered globally. **The Role** Share's infrastructure runs the marketplace: every API call, every monitoring signal, every system that keeps carriers, ISPs, and enterprise buyers transacting without interruption. We're looking for a senior Platform Engineer to scale that infrastructure at the pace the marketplace is growing: modern, cloud-native infrastructure: Kubernetes, cloud architecture, containers and virtualization, and the APIs and DevOps practices holding it all together. This isn't just an operational role. We need someone who leads, who catches problems before they escalate, who pushes the team toward better decisions based on knowledge and experience. You'll work alongside our systems engineer and very closely with the network and software teams. **Our Ideal Candidate** * 7+ years of professional systems/infrastructure engineering experience, with real ownership of infrastructure at scale. * A leadership mindset, not just an operational one; you take responsibility for outcomes, catch issues before they become incidents, and push for the right call for your team and the company. * Deep Kubernetes expertise: you've deployed, scaled, and debugged production clusters. * Strong cloud infrastructure experience (GCP preferred): networking, IAM, cost and capacity planning, multi-region architecture. * Real depth across the full stack, old and new: production Docker and container orchestration, and virtualization technologies (VMware, KVM, Hyper-V or similar). You're equally comfortable from the VM layer up through containers and orchestration, not specialized in just one. * Deep production API design and management experience. * AI-native in your workflow: you've built with these tools, not just used them, and can show the leverage you've gained. * You ship, and you drive. Handed a systems problem, you scope it, build it, own it through production, and use what you've learned to push the department forward. **Compensation \& Benefits** Competitive salary (top of the local market where you are located) and meaningful equity in a mission-driven, investor-backed company A high-ownership environment with a steep but well-supported learning curve, and a team that writes things down.
